emotional_tone: Authoritative, Prestigious, Intellectually Rigorous, Finance-Native, Modern Editorial
target_audience: Indian finance students, equity research aspirants, financial modeling enthusiasts

hero_visual.concept: Finance-Native Live Market Chart & DCF Financial Model Dashboard

components.name: Live Market Candlestick & Volume Chart
components.description: Canvas/SVG-rendered interactive candlestick & line chart showing live price movements, 50-day moving average curve, volume bars, MACD indicator line, and real-time live ticker updating every 2 seconds.

components.name: DCF Valuation & Sensitivity Matrix Overlay
components.description: Interactive DCF modeling card with live inputs for WACC (10.5%), Terminal Growth (3.5%), Implied Enterprise Value (₹1,42,500 Cr), target price calculation (₹3,210), and sensitivity table matrix highlight.
components.interaction: Hovering over DCF cells updates intrinsic value forecast calculation live with smooth framer-motion transitions.

sections.name: Editorial Navigation Bar
sections.layout: Sticky glassmorphism header with top ticker bar for market stats, logo, clear desktop nav links, dark/light toggle, and action CTAs.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.layout: Asymmetric 12-column split layout. Left 7 cols: Eyebrow + Serif Headline + Course specs badge grid + Primary CTAs. Right 5 cols: Finance-native Animated Candlestick Chart + DCF Model component.

sections.name: Built On Real Markets (Social Proof Strip)
sections.layout: Editorial newspaper ticker strip featuring 6 major Indian market wordmarks (RELIANCE, HDFC BANK, INFOSYS, TCS, TATA STEEL, ICICI BANK) and 3 career role dossier cards (Equity Research, Investment Banking, Asset Management).

sections.name: Your Instructors (Faculty Section)
sections.layout: 3-column editorial profile grid with refined typography, initial avatars / professional portraits, credentials badge, and detailed bio blocks.

sections.name: The Gap No One Talks About (Problem Section)
sections.layout: 2x4 asymmetric grid of gap dossier cards with mono index numbers (01 to 08), tags, icons, title, 3 key bullet points, and analytical body text.

sections.name: The Platform (14 Units Features Section)
sections.layout: High-density editorial Bento grid showcasing 14 feature units with icon badges, concise headers, and crisp description summaries.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Elevate card with shadow-md, subtle transform -translate-y-1, border color accent change
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable canvas animations and translate transforms when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is true

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT change any existing content or copy. Only restyle and re-layout the elements.
Preserve all existing data-testid attributes across all components.
Follow the light editorial finance theme as default with warm paper background (#FBF9F5) and serif headlines, and support dark mode seamlessly.
Ensure the hero section includes the live animated candlestick market chart and DCF model visual.
Ensure zero transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays to avoid text collision.
Use framer-motion for micro-interactions and smooth section reveals.
